brand.purpose: Planum wordmark at 19px and weight 600; visually hidden in the phone masthead.

headline.purpose: Selected region, deficit, and circuit landmark names at 24px and weight 600.

caption.purpose: Masthead captions, stage popover field labels, notes, status bar, browse scope, facts labels, list column heads and group headings; no letter-spacing.

measurement.purpose: Measured quantities and coordinates retain the surrounding sans face with tabular figures.

field-label.purpose: Panel field labels and segmented choices; masthead and stage popover captions use the caption role.

source-data.purpose: Source IDs, file names, and voxel indices use the 13px monospace role.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Masthead popovers, skip link, dialogs; dark theme 0.4 / 0.3.

shadows.name: marking-halo
shadows.value: -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--overlay-halo-core); text-shadow: 0 0 1px var(--overlay-halo-core), 0 0 2px var(--overlay-halo-core), 0 0 4px var(--overlay-halo-core), 0 0 8px var(--overlay-halo)
shadows.purpose: Orientation letters and scale bar over anatomy.

motion.name: ui-feedback
motion.purpose: Color feedback on controls and rows.

motion.name: camera-and-sheet
motion.purpose: Camera reframing and settled pointer sheet movement use 240ms; drags track directly. Keyboard sheet activation uses data-instant, and pointer cancellation returns to the prior detent.

motion.name: dialog-entry
motion.purpose: Centered scale(0.98) and opacity entry with a fading backdrop.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animations use 0.01ms; entries and sheet movement retain opacity transitions without travel or scale.

motion.name: loading-progress
motion.purpose: Existing loading progress synchronization; retain alongside settled sheet height/width motion.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pointer commands scale to 0.97; keyboard actions and list places stay still.

motion.name: popover
motion.purpose: Anchored scale(0.97) entry; masthead popovers close immediately.

motion.name: tooltip
motion.purpose: 500ms initial hover delay; instant entry for keyboard and a 300ms follow-on window; 150ms departure delay allows pointer travel.

components.name: Selected Anatomical Row
components.description: Tree and mode-list rows share one row height (32px fine, 44px coarse) with the teal wash for selection. L and R eye slots at control height end on the panel’s far edge, Mid reserved only by sections with midline parts; side letters and counts end on one right edge. With a mouse a region keeps its letter and shows its 14px eye on hover, focus, selection or when hidden; a group shows its count in the eye area and trades it for its eyes on hover, keyboard focus, or a hidden or partial side. Touch keeps every eye. Long names wrap.

components.name: Region Details
components.description: A 24px/600 headline, then hemisphere and group as 14px context 4px below. One left-aligned row of tonal Focus, Isolate, Hide and accent-ink Linked MRI at control height follows after 16px with 8px gaps (one line in the 320px panel); an active Isolate takes the teal wash and a 1px accent edge. narrative.overview:
A calm clinical workspace in light or dark around a dark imaging stage. The masthead holds the available data choices in one compact bar, one task panel searches and drills into it, and the stage carries the tools that act on the picture. Keep the Planum name, the cut-away brain mark, and English and French copy.

This is a visual direction, not a clinical claim. Preserve the “not clinical anatomy” statement, scientific geometry, measurements, source labels, provenance, and published data colours. Panel theme and renderer keep independent palettes.
keyCharacteristics: Three homes: masthead = data and workspace settings, panel = exploration modes and drill-in, stage = section and display tools.
One continuous workspace with clear task groups and quiet scientific tables; one fine rule separates navigation from the stage.
Three button ranks, one segmented vocabulary, one disclosure, one chevron.
Flat surfaces; clear selected, focused, and disabled states.

rules.name: The Independent Palettes Rule
rules.body: UI teal communicates interaction. Tissue shading, atlas and network colours, streamline direction colours, outlines, orientation, and scale markings retain their scientific meaning in both themes.

rules.name: The Complete Name Rule
rules.body: Allow anatomical names and localized control labels to wrap. Prefer word boundaries; allow emergency wrapping when an anatomical name itself exceeds the panel at enlarged text sizes. Action rows wrap by content. Keep hemisphere labels explicit; truncate only compact selection readouts, the masthead summary, and constrained navigation labels.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and fine borders for the workspace. Reserve shadows for masthead popovers and dialogs.

dos: Do use the shared palette, spacing, typography, and radius tokens in viewer/styles/tokens.css.
Do keep data choices in the masthead, exploration modes and drill-in in the panel, and picture tools on the stage; phones mirror the modes in the sheet.
Do preserve visible focus, ARIA semantics, keyboard operation, and English and French at every breakpoint.
Do maintain readable hover, selected, disabled, empty, loading, and error states in both themes; text at least 4.5:1, field outlines and state edges at least 3:1.
Do verify UI changes in the browser and with the existing tests.
donts: Don’t recolour scientific data to match the UI accent or replace real anatomy with synthetic illustrations.
Don’t hide the “not clinical anatomy” statement in settings or add unsupported claims.
Don’t stack navigation rows: one location bar per detail view.
Don’t add a second filled button to a view, a new selected-state idiom, or a second disclosure style.
Don’t add decorative icon backgrounds, count badges, redundant controls, or ornamental motion.
